meta.name: baoyu-translate
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "translate", "翻译", "精翻", "translate article", "translate to Chinese", "translate to English", "改成中文", "改成英文", "convert to Chinese", "localize", "本地化", "refined translation", "精细翻译", "proofread translation", "快速翻译", "快翻", "这篇文章翻译一下", or provides a URL/file with translation intent. Supports three modes (quick/normal/refined) with custom glossary support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容翻译成多种语言
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高质量翻译或本地化内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality translation or localization

howto.what: 当你要翻译文章或文档时,Claude 会按 quick(快翻)、normal(普通)、refined(精翻)三种模式翻译,产出 translation.md,并保留原有 markdown 格式。
howto.when: 当你提到「翻译」「精翻」「快翻」等词,或给出 URL/文件并带翻译意图时触发。首次使用会先让你设置目标语言、模式等偏好。

say.text: 把这篇英文文章精翻成中文

say.note: 用 quick 模式直接翻译,不分块

say.text: 把这篇文章本地化,读者是普通读者
say.note: 翻译时套用 general 读者预设

howto.what_en: When you translate an article or document, Claude runs one of three modes (quick, normal, refined), writes translation.md, and keeps the original markdown formatting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'translate', '精翻' and similar, or hand over a URL or file with translation intent. First use asks you to set language, mode and other preferences.

say_en.text: Refine-translate this English article into Chinese
say_en.note: Runs the refined workflow and saves translation.md
Uses quick mode, direct, no chunking

say_en.text: Localize this article for general readers
say_en.note: Translates with the general audience preset
